name: Deliver the Shipment
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
While I fix this wagon, adventurer, I have one last task for you.

I have packed the most vital supplies saved from the ogre attacks.  Take them to Nethergarde Keep.  The keep is nestled in the northern hills of the Blasted Lands, keeping watch over the Dark Portal.

To reach Nethergard, follow the road east.  When it branches head south into the Blasted Lands, then turn left at the next fork.  Follow the road, adventurer, and be wary.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Shipment to Nethergarde to Quartermaster Lungertz in Nethergarde Keep.
narrative.offerRewardText:
What? A package from Biggs' caravan? We thought it, and he, were lost.

Thank you, adventurer. With luck, these supplies will carry the much needed reagent, Azoran Crystals. Our stock is running low...

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 35 to 42, 11,600 XP in all.

quests.name: Encroaching Wildlife
quests.objectiveText: Kill 8 Young Sawtooth Crocolisks, 10 Sorrow Spinners and 10 Swamp Jaguars then return to Watcher Biggs in the Swamp of Sorrows.

quests.name: The Lost Caravan
quests.objectiveText: Find the Caravan Chest in the Fallow Sanctuary, obtain the Wizards' Reagents and bring to Watcher Biggs.

quests.name: Driftwood
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 pieces of Sundried Driftwood to Watcher Biggs in the Swamp of Sorrows.

quests.name: Deliver the Shipment
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Shipment to Nethergarde to Quartermaster Lungertz in Nethergarde Keep.
